statement: Let M be a rationally connected smooth projective fourfold with h3,1 (M) = 1, rank TM = 21, | disc TM | = d > 2, EndHdg(TM,Q) = Q. Let S consist of the Picard-number-one K3 surfaces S whose shifted integral transcendental lattice (TS(−1), −qS) is Hodge-isometric to (TM , qM ), and use this collection in the test u of the preliminary section. If f : P4 99K M is a birational map, then cu(f) = 1. Every member of S has degree d and trivial automorphism group.
